[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]

== Biography ==
Janet is represented in the held Calton burial-index citation as Mrs Janet Scott, with surnames Glasgow and Scott, buried on 9 July 1840, aged 49, with fever noted. Her age implies an approximate birth around 1791, not a recorded birthday. The existing Glasgow birth-surname and Calton birthplace fields remain profile claims rather than facts independently established by this burial citation.
== Research Notes ==
=== Existing Calton citation matched: 4 November 2026 ===

The newly inspected OPR derivative records Mrs Janet Glasgow Or Scott, aged 49, with 9 July 1840 labelled as death, Glasgow, OPR 644/67, item 3, page 167. The complete source citation already preserved in this profile names Mrs Janet Scott, both Glasgow and Scott surnames, Calton burial on the same day, the same age and fever. This is an exact correspondence to the source-defined woman represented by this existing profile, rather than only a name-and-age comparison. It does not prove every biographical claim or independently establish which surname was natal.<ref name="Janet1840OPR">Findmypast, Scotland, Parish Deaths &amp; Burials 1564–2017, [https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=SCOT%2FOPR%2FBUR%2F1183694 Mrs Janet Glasgow Or Scott, SCOT/OPR/BUR/1183694], OPR 644/67, item 3, page 167; derivative inspected 4 November 2026, original register uninspected.</ref>

The held Calton companion GBPRS/GLASGOW/BUR/093167 labels 9 July as burial and gives the exact death day as unknown; the new OPR derivative labels that day as death. Preserve those distinct labels without adopting a new exact death date. The new transcript does not supply fever or a Calton burial field; those details come from the held Calton citation and companion, not the new OPR fields. These derivatives may describe one event and are not independent witnesses. The original register is uninspected.<ref>Findmypast, [https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=GBPRS%2FGLASGOW%2FBUR%2F093167 Mrs Janet Glasgow, GBPRS/GLASGOW/BUR/093167], Calton, burial 9 July 1840, age 49, fever; derivative captured 24 October 2026, reused without refetch. Exact death day unknown in this companion.</ref>

No spouse forename, parent, child or other secondary person is named in the new transcript. The title Mrs and compound Glasgow Or Scott do not by themselves prove a marriage, natal surname orientation, or an individual Scott spouse. No relationship, confidence percentage or model vital field is changed. The former weak-comparison assessment for the 1840 event is superseded only by the exact existing citation correspondence described here.

The separately indexed Janet Mrs Glasgow, buried at Calton on 26 May 1843, aged 51, with dropsy (GBPRS/GLASGOW/BUR/093165), is a distinct deceased woman: a person buried in 1840 cannot also be buried in 1843. The new compound-name OPR transcript SCOT/OPR/BUR/1185627 corresponds to the complete existing citation of [[Gilmour-965|Janet Gilmour]], identifying that separate source-defined 1843 woman. The older weak comparison to this 1840 profile is superseded; neither woman’s natal-surname orientation or family is independently proved by these entries. It is not an alternative death for the woman represented by this profile’s 1840 citation. No new person is proposed for the separate 1843 record from this bounded review.

=== Preserved prior opening ===

The original opening stated: “Janet was born in 1791.” That year is retained as an age-derived estimate, not a separately recorded birthday.
